title: Building hub Internet loan terms
titleZh: 社區服務中心網路借用條款
passage:
Oakbarrow Building Hub | Temporary Internet Kits
We lend pocket routers to residents whose home Internet service is being installed or repaired. Existing users who want a faster connection should speak to their own provider. Our kits are a temporary replacement, not an upgrade.
A pocket router creates a new Wi-Fi network. It does not restore the old network name. To connect a device, use the network name and password printed inside the kit lid. The hub can print the instructions in larger type. It cannot change the password on a borrowed router.
Kits are due back on the date printed on the loan slip. When returning a kit, include the router and its charging cable. You do not need to include the separate paper instructions.
A connected device can still show “No Internet.” If it is connected to the kit's network and the router's status light is orange, move the router closer to a window. If the light stays orange there, call the hub; the home Internet provider does not maintain the kit. If the light turns blue, try opening a page again. Once the kit is working, there is no need to reset a device that has already joined its network.
passageZh:
Oakbarrow 社區服務中心｜臨時網路套組
家用網路正在裝設或維修的住戶，可以借用隨身路由器。已有網路而希望提高速度的住戶，請洽原網路業者。套組是臨時替代方案，不是升級方案。
隨身路由器會建立新的 Wi-Fi 網路，不會恢復原來的網路名稱。裝置連線時，請使用套組盒蓋內側印的網路名稱和密碼。服務中心可印製大字版說明，但不能更改出借路由器的密碼。
請依借用單所列日期歸還套組。歸還時請附上路由器和充電線，另附的紙本說明則無須歸還。
裝置已連線，仍可能顯示「沒有網際網路」。若裝置已連到套組的網路，且路由器狀態燈亮橘色，請把路由器移到靠窗處。若在窗邊仍亮橘燈，請打電話給服務中心；家用網路業者不負責維護套組。若燈號轉藍，請再試著開啟網頁。套組恢復連線後，已加入套組網路的裝置不用重設。
